description: The Bo District Health Management Team is planning a new ambulance routing system and needs to visualize the service coverage of their hospitals. Using the DHIS2 Maps app at http://localhost:8080 (login: admin / district), create a new map visualization named 'Bo Hospital 5km Catchment'. Add an 'Organisation units' layer that displays ONLY the facilities in 'Bo' district that belong to the 'Hospital' Organisation Unit Group (or 'District Hospital' / 'Referral Hospital' if 'Hospital' is not available). Configure this layer to show a 5000m (5km) buffer radius around each hospital. Save the map.
